verdict.rationale: Choosing a data storage region or residency is a fair question for a hosted LLM inference API, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions regions, data residency, or a storage location choice. Service tiers (on-demand, flex, auto) govern latency and throughput, not where data is stored, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
